name: GPU-based Ray Traversal on Tetrahedral Meshes
aliases: GPU-based Ray Tracing on Tetrahedral Meshes
Weiler et al. GPU Ray Casting
definition: A smoke volume rendering approach using GPU-based ray tracing on tetrahedral meshes, utilizing fast ray traversal executed on the graphics adapter by storing vertex and adjacency data in texture memory to enable concurrent mesh traversal.
summary: GPU-based Ray Traversal on Tetrahedral Meshes renders static volumes by concurrently traversing unstructured tetrahedral meshes via neighbor pointers, differing from grid sampling by using explicit adjacency.
